Officers were called to the scene at around 18:41 on the London-bound carriageway between junctions eight and nine, near Hollingbourne, Maidstone. Eleven people were cared for by paramedics and two taken to hospital, Kent Fire and Rescue Service said. The Woodmont girls volleyball coach vividly recalled last season when the Wildcats defeated North Myrtle Beach in a five-set thriller to claim the school's first state championship in 47 years . Her father, Jimmy Gilbert, occupied that special spot in the bleachers. Before the season started, Gilbert died. And after Woodmont (42-2) defeated Wando (37-7) in four sets (19-25, 25-20, 25-22, 25-22) to win the SCHSL Class 5A state championship on Nov. 7 at Dreher High School, all Horgan could think about was how proud her father would be.

Sanford's 51-yard TD run with 5:10 remaining gave the Cougars (7-2, 4-2 Big 12) the lead. Cincinnati (5-4, 2-4) drove to the Houston 42, but a throw by JC French IV was ruled a backward pass after a replay review, and Houston recovered with 2:11 remaining.
